result.title: Bayesian Learning to Select Fair Classifiers
result.summary: Evaluations of classifiers (AI or human or agents) often assume a batch setting in which every agent produces labels on every example in a test set, which can be expensive or impractical in many contexts. This motivates online policies that adaptively select agents to query as examples arrive and update policies as outcomes are observed. We study the problem of selecting, in an online stream, the agent that best balances (i) predictive performance and (ii) subgroup fairness of a sensitive attribute, and that allows for delayed observations of true class labels. We formulate this as a Bayesian multi-armed bandit problem using Thompson Sampling, explicitly balancing accuracy and fairness. We conduct empirical evaluations on real-world datasets spanning problems involving tabular classifiers, large language models, and human labelers, demonstrating substantial reductions in regret relative to baselines. Our theoretical contributions include guarantees on the performance of the selected agent that incorporate both the accuracy and fairness aspects of the problem.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文把「在线数据流中挑选能同时平衡预测性能与敏感属性子群公平性的智能体」建模为贝叶斯多臂老虎机，用 Thompson Sampling 在允许真实标签延迟到达的条件下更新选择策略，并在表格模型、大语言模型和人类标注者等真实数据集上评估遗憾下降，同时给出兼顾准确性与公平性的性能保证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其老虎机式的自适应查询选择与延迟结果下的策略更新，可能为 LVR 中「何时调用视觉证据、动态分配算力、以及延迟监督下的贡献分配」提供问题框架与评价思路；但论文不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态，联系较远，线索仅供核查。
